name: texpaste
title: TeXPaste
description: Type LaTeX and paste it into Keynote as a crisp vector equation (PDF, SVG or PNG), with live preview, history, templates and custom macros.
author: royabhi028

commands.name: tex
commands.title: Paste LaTeX Equation
commands.subtitle: TeXPaste
commands.description: Render LaTeX with a live preview and paste it as PDF, SVG or PNG.

commands.name: pick-color
commands.title: Pick Equation Color
commands.description: Pick the equation color from anywhere on screen with the eyedropper.

preferences.name: color
preferences.title: Equation Color
preferences.description: Hex color, e.g. #000000 or #FFFFFF. ⌘T toggles black/white.

preferences.name: fontSize
preferences.title: Font Size (pt)
preferences.description: Size the equation is pasted at.

preferences.name: inlineStyle
preferences.title: Math Style
preferences.label: Use inline (text) style instead of display style
preferences.description: Render equations in inline (text) style instead of display style.

preferences.name: autoPaste
preferences.title: Enter Behaviour
preferences.label: Auto-paste into the frontmost app (⌘⏎ copies only)
preferences.description: Paste the equation into the frontmost app after copying it.
